data.title: 法琳 · 叶背上有个小客人
data.description: 采药的小路边，法琳托起一片宽叶，发现叶背停着一只小甲虫。她没有把叶子摘下，只蹲在那里看它慢慢爬过叶脉。
data.promptProse: Beside a woodland herb path, Falin wears a moss-green cloak and brown wool trousers. She crouches and supports an attached broad leaf from below, watching a tiny beetle move along its veins. Dappled sunlight filters through the trees onto her hands and the living plant.
data.animaCaption: The leaf remains attached to the plant, and the beetle stays on its surface.
data.action: 托住仍连着枝茎的叶子观察小甲虫
